description: Margin-recovery probe on the last untested SGD-group setting. Base: E058. Change only the BatchNorm-bias lr multiplier, from x64 to x32 (relative to the current x1.5-scaled SGD base lr), and double the BN-bias wd so lr*wd stays constant. The head (x2, wd halved), whitening bias, Muon, lookahead, curriculum, freeze, jitter and epochs are all unchanged. The lr is a 0-d tensor / eager param-group value, so there are no new shapes and nothing recompiles.
